name: METEORA_DISCOVER_URL
description: Base URL for Meteora pool discovery.

name: POLL_INTERVAL
description: Time between polls of each enabled discovery mode.

name: HERMES_WEBHOOK_URL
description: Hermes profile webhook endpoint for signal batches.

name: HERMES_WEBHOOK_SECRET
description: Shared HMAC secret matching the Hermes webhook subscription.

name: REDIS_ADDR
description: Redis host:port; empty selects in-memory dedup.

name: REDISCLI_AUTH
description: Redis password shared by the daemon and redis-cli subprocesses.

name: REDIS_SEEN_KEY
description: Redis namespace for pool dedup keys.

name: SEEN_TTL
description: Default rolling pool dedup duration.

name: TURNOVER_SEEN_TTL
description: Solana turnover pool dedup duration.

name: CASUAL_SEEN_TTL
description: Solana casual pool dedup duration.

name: PULSE_SEEN_TTL
description: Solana pulse pool dedup duration.

name: ENABLE_CASUAL
description: Enable Solana casual discovery.

name: ENABLE_MULTIDAY
description: Enable Solana multiday discovery.

name: ENABLE_TURNOVER
description: Enable experimental Solana turnover discovery.

name: ENABLE_PULSE
description: Enable Solana pulse discovery.

name: ENABLE_MOMENTUM_GATE
description: Reject downtrending candidates when momentum data is available.

name: ENABLE_AUDIT_GATE
description: Check token holder quality with the Jupiter audit API.

name: ENABLE_GMGN_GATE
description: Enrich candidates with GMGN holder and security checks when a key is configured.

name: GMGN_API_KEY

name: GMGN_MAX_RAT_PCT

name: GMGN_MAX_BUNDLER_PCT
description: Maximum bundler volume percentage; nonpositive disables this gate.

name: BIRDEYE_API_KEY
description: Optional Birdeye candle API credential.

name: BIRDEYE_MAX_RPM
description: Shared Birdeye requests per minute budget.

name: ENABLE_PVP_CHECK
description: Flag competing same-symbol pools when discovery data is available.

name: ROBINHOOD_MATURE

name: ROBINHOOD_PULSE_LADDER

name: ROBINHOOD_TURNOVER
description: Enable Robinhood turnover discovery.

name: ROBINHOOD_DISCOVER_URL

name: ROBINHOOD_SEEN_TTL
description: Robinhood default pool dedup duration.

name: ROBINHOOD_STOCK_SEEN_TTL
description: USDG equity pool dedup duration.

name: ROBINHOOD_MIN_HOLDERS
description: Minimum known token holder count.

name: ROBINHOOD_WEBHOOK
description: Forward Robinhood batches to Hermes instead of observing only.

name: ROBINHOOD_DEPLOY_ENABLED
description: Enable direct deployment for the selected Robinhood modes.

name: ROBINHOOD_DEPLOY_MODES
description: Comma-separated Robinhood modes allowed to deploy.

name: ROBINHOOD_EXECUTOR_CMD
description: Whitespace-split command for the Robinhood v3 executor.

name: ROBINHOOD_V4_EXECUTOR_CMD
description: Optional whitespace-split command for the Robinhood v4 executor.

name: ROBINHOOD_DEPLOY_TIMEOUT
description: Maximum duration of a Robinhood direct deploy.

name: ROBINHOOD_DEPLOY_STRATEGY
description: Robinhood position strategy; turnover pins its own strategy.

name: ROBINHOOD_RANGE_PCT
description: Position range percentage for balanced_tight.

name: ROBINHOOD_SLIPPAGE_PCT
description: Swap slippage percentage for balanced_tight.

description: Maximum funded Robinhood pools.

name: ROBINHOOD_MAX_PER_TOKEN
description: Maximum funded pools per underlying token; zero disables.

description: WETH ladder rung width in ticks.

description: Minimum WETH allocated to the smallest rung.

name: UNI_LADDER_STALE_TICKS
description: WETH ladder drift threshold before re-pinning.

name: UNI_LADDER_RUNG_TICKS_USDG
description: USDG ladder rung width in ticks.

name: UNI_LADDER_STALE_TICKS_USDG
description: USDG ladder drift threshold before re-pinning.

name: UNI_LADDER_FILL_HARD_PCT

name: UNI_LADDER_IDLE_MIN_AGE

name: UNI_LADDER_IDLE_WINDOW
description: Fee-productivity observation window in minutes.

description: Minimum fee growth percentage over the idle window.

name: KRYSTAL_API_KEY

name: KRYSTAL_WALLET

name: KRYSTAL_API_URL
description: Base URL for the optional Krystal fee oracle.

name: KRYSTAL_TIMEOUT
description: Krystal API timeout in seconds.

name: ROBINHOOD_INDICATOR_GATE
description: Use Supertrend and RSI entry timing checks.

name: ROBINHOOD_ONCHAIN_CANDLES
description: Rebuild missing candles from on-chain swap logs.

name: ROBINHOOD_RPC_URL
description: Robinhood Chain JSON-RPC endpoint.

description: WETH reserve excluded from position sizing.

description: Minimum WETH position size.

description: Maximum WETH position size.

name: ROBINHOOD_DEPLOY_RESERVE_USDG
description: USDG reserve excluded from position sizing.

name: ROBINHOOD_DEPLOY_PCT_USDG
description: Fraction of deployable USDG committed to one position.

name: ROBINHOOD_DEPLOY_FLOOR_USDG
description: Minimum USDG position size.

name: ROBINHOOD_DEPLOY_CEIL_USDG
description: Maximum USDG position size.

name: ROBINHOOD_TENURE_PROBE_CYCLES
description: Completed pool cycles required to leave probe sizing.

name: ROBINHOOD_TENURE_FULL_CYCLES
description: Completed pool cycles required for full sizing.

name: ROBINHOOD_TENURE_MIN_SAMPLE
description: Minimum completed cycles before rejecting by fill fraction.

name: ROBINHOOD_MIN_GAS_ETH
description: Minimum native ETH gas reserve required before deployment.

name: LONE_MIN_SCORE

name: DEPLOY_TIMEOUT
description: Maximum duration of a deterministic Solana deploy.

name: REPORT_REJECTS
description: Also deliver rejected outcomes to the report command.

name: DLMM_HELIUS_WALLET_PRICES

name: DASHBOARD_PASSWORD_HASH
description: PBKDF2 dashboard password hash, configured in a private unit environment file.

name: DASHBOARD_EXTRA_UNITS
description: Extra user unit names to display on the dashboard.

name: DASHBOARD_HIDE_KEYS

name: DLMM_BRACKET_REJECTS

name: SOLANA_CANDIDATE_WATCH_PATH
